activity.notes: Records Raden Wijaya (Kertarajasa Jayawardhana) as founder and first ruler of Majapahit, 1293–1309. The existing canonical Majapahit polity is reused rather than recreated.

sources.title: Kampanye Digital Objek Pemajuan Kebudayaan 'Tari Tribuana Tunggadewi' — Balai Pelestarian Kebudayaan Wilayah XI
sources.citation_text: Indonesia's cultural preservation office identifies Dyah Wijaya, commonly known as Raden Wijaya, as founder of Majapahit and gives his reign as 1293–1309.

sources.title: Candi Simping — Balai Pelestarian Kebudayaan Wilayah XI
sources.citation_text: The Indonesian cultural preservation office identifies Kertarajasa Jayawardhana/Raden Wijaya as the first king of Majapahit and records his death in 1309.
